title: Note: talking to the fast assistant alone

text: Dispatch is paused: a file, %LOCALAPPDATA%/lew42/servex/dispatch.off, now exists, and while it does a spoken task is carded and marked queued but nobody is spawned. Delete the file to resume. Softer lever: begin with note: or ask a question - those never spawn anyone. The assistant itself never spawns; only the Dispatcher does.
